name: FGVC Aircraft
description: FGVC Aircraft (Fine-Grained Visual Classification of Aircraft) is a benchmark dataset of 10,200 aircraft images across 100 model variants (102 images per variant). Aircraft categories are organized in a four-level hierarchy: Model, Variant, Family, and Manufacturer.

publisher.name: Visual Geometry Group (VGG), University of Oxford

license.name: Open Academic Research Use
license.notes: Freely available for academic research and evaluation.

source_references.title: Fine-Grained Visual Classification of Aircraft (arXiv 2013)
source_references.notes: Original technical report on FGVC aircraft dataset.
